_comment: Copy to eformify_config.json and edit. doctors: the signing-physician dropdown, in display order. msp = the practitioner number printed on requisitions (provider.ohip_no in OSCAR, NOT billing_no which is usually a clinic group number). sig = signature image filename inside OSCAR's eform images directory (/var/lib/OscarDocument/oscar/eform/images/) — omit it to fall back to the handwriting pad.
